metadata.description: Claude Code plugins, curated and shareable

plugins.name: notebooklm-connector
plugins.description: A plugin to manage NotebookLM notebooks and query them using integrated features.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Personal utility commands and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: vision-powers
plugins.description: Visual report generation suite: wiki analysis, diff review, plan review, project recap, fact-checking, and report management with interactive diagrams and curated design system

plugins.name: worktree-plus
plugins.description: Enhanced git worktree: custom branch prefix, remote branch tracking, selective copy/symlink for gitignored files, work state protection on cleanup

plugins.name: skill-creator-pro
plugins.description: Create, test, measure, and iteratively improve Claude Code skills with category-aware design, gotchas-driven development, progressive disclosure coaching, and automated description optimization

plugins.name: codex-advisor
plugins.description: Integrate OpenAI Codex CLI for code review and verification with Claude's critical evaluation. Auto-suggests review after commits and verification after task completion.

plugins.name: rubber-duck-tutor
plugins.description: Rubber duck tutor that combats rubber-stamping in AI-assisted workflows. Interactive learning sessions for plan review, code verification, and PR review, with auto-hooks for post-commit and post-plan suggestions.
